title: Norml WordPress Copilot
audience: WordPress site owners and content teams
actsOn: one connected WordPress site through REST
pitch: Connect once, let the AI map your WordPress site, then manage the surfaces it can actually reach in plain language.
problem: Small WordPress changes pile up when the person who knows what should change is not comfortable making it in wp-admin.
Every site exposes a different mix of content, fields, plugins, and permissions. The Copilot maps this site first and writes the real boundary into capabilities.md instead of guessing.

callout.label: API, not server access
callout.text: This is the **content and administration Copilot**. Code, WP-CLI, SSH, GitHub, database work, and deployment belong to **Norml WordPress Copilot Advanced**.

capabilities.label: What it does
capabilities.lede: The generated capability map is specific to the connected role and current site.

items.name: Edit and publish content
items.desc: Pages, posts, media, terms, schedules, and exposed custom content.

items.name: Map the site once
items.desc: Records identity, site basics, content model, plugins, theme, and REST surface.

items.name: Write capabilities.md
items.desc: Explains what this login can read, create, update, and delete.

items.name: Remember safely
items.desc: Keeps site notes and a change log outside the skill package.

items.name: Change code or server state
items.desc: Routes theme, plugin, SSH, database, GitHub, and deployment work onward.

flow.d: Authorize a dedicated WordPress Application Password outside chat.
Run a read-only scan of the real site and connected role.
Write capabilities.md and the detailed site dossier.
Describe the WordPress result you want in plain language.
Confirm the write and append the durable change log.

commands: explain this site and what you can safely change
fix the typo on my About page
publish this draft with its category and featured image
show which content types are writable through this login
find media items missing alt text
rescan the site; I added a plugin and custom post type

limits.label: Boundary
items: No theme or plugin code, SSH, WP-CLI, SQL, GitHub, or deployment.
No claim that a field is editable unless the live REST capability check supports it.
Opaque page-builder canvas data stays out of scope unless a supported API exposes it safely.
Broad, destructive, access, and site-wide writes require confirmation.
limits.note: When REST is the wrong layer, it points to wp-admin or Norml WordPress Copilot Advanced.

architecture.label: Inside the skill
architecture.lede: The installed package separates the runtime boundary, the two onboarding paths, local credential handoff, reusable operations, bundled WordPress knowledge, and generated dossier contracts.

items.role: Runtime entry point, REST capability boundary, safety gates, and request router.
Chooses terminal or Desktop / Cowork onboarding without mixing their credential paths.
Terminal setup, protected secret capture, connection test, and first read-only scan.
Desktop / Cowork setup through a local, short-lived credential handoff.
No-network local connector used only for the Desktop / Cowork handoff.
Cross-platform setup, import, connection, scanning, and WordPress REST helpers.
Bundled REST, ACF, architecture, plugin, and safety guidance.
Contracts for capabilities, notes, changelog, config, and the per-site README.

architecture.note: This installed source stays separate from the per-site dossier the Copilot creates on the user’s computer.
